166:t_038:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have nothing to say to you now! I'll surpass you!」

166:t_038:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Fighting me and lending $$フロンタル$$ a hand should be two separate things.」

166:t_038:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're not the only one I have to surpass! $$フロンタル$$ too!」

166:t_038:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「And the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ you threw away, I'll be the one to lead it!」

166:t_038:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Come, $$シャア・アズナブル$$! I'll end the legend of the $$赤い彗星$$ myself!」

166:t_038:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! You're still...!」

166:t_038:8.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I won't let anyone interfere! This is the life I chose!」

166:t_039:1.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「You again! You're so persistent!」

166:t_039:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't give up! I'll call out to you as many times as it takes!」

166:t_039:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「For the sake of Captain $$ジンネマン$$, who loves you!」

166:t_039:5.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$プルトゥエルブ$$! Calm down and listen only to my words!」

166:t_039:7.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Any words but mine are the words of the enemy, meant to confuse you!」

166:t_039:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$アルベルト$$! What kind of man are you...!」

166:t_039:9.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! It's all your fault for being the one who was chosen!」

166:t_039:10.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「$$ガンダム$$! For my Master's sake, I will destroy you!」

166:t_039:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$! At this rate, the system will take you over again...!」

166:t_040:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$マリーダ$$, it's me! Remember! It's $$クェス$$!」

166:t_040:1.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Why is $$ネオ・ジオン$$ with the $$ガンダム$$!」

166:t_040:2.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「$$ジオン$$... $$ガンダム$$... Gh...!」

166:t_040:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「Don't give in, $$マリーダ$$! You're someone who understands, I know it!」

166:t_040:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「I'm sure you can beat those fake memories and find the truth!」

166:t_040:5.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「The truth... that is...」

166:t_040:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's the same...! Just like when I was put on the $$α・アジール$$...!」

166:t_040:8.en:
$$クェス$$
「I don't need any machine that tramples on people's hearts! Wait for me, $$マリーダ$$!」

166:t_100:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I'll protect you, $$オードリー$$...!)

166:t_100:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(This is what my fight... what the $$ユニコーン$$ is for!)

166:t_100:2.en:
$$リディ$$
($$ミネバ$$... I won't hesitate anymore...)

166:t_100:3.en:
$$リディ$$
(I won't chase after you...! But I'll make you turn around and look at me, no matter what!)

166:t_101:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$クェス$$... I'm putting you through a lot.」

166:t_101:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「None of that. You're the one who broadened my world, Colonel.」

166:t_101:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「I see... You're wise, $$クェス$$.」

166:t_101:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「Heh... I'm not going to be a kid forever, you know. So you don't have to play the father anymore, Colonel.」

166:t_101:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「Don't live a role somebody else wanted for you. Live like yourself, Colonel.」

166:t_101:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「...You're right. I'm no longer the $$赤い彗星$$ of $$ジオン$$, after all.」

166:t_102:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Heh... We're a pair with neither glamour nor youth, Major.」

166:t_102:1.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「To make up for it, we have experience.」

166:t_102:2.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Understood...! Then shall we show them how professionals fight!」

166:t_102:3.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Right...! A $$エコーズ$$ and $$トライスター$$ team-up!」

166:t_103:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「So you're coming, $$ガンダム$$!」

166:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$マリーダ$$... Even if the existence of the $$ガンダム$$ warped your fate, I'll fight with this power...!」

166:t_103:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ユニコーン$$ is my possibility...! And with this power, I'll save you too!」

166:t_104:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Why is the $$赤い彗星$$ with the $$ガンダム$$!」

166:t_104:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$プルトゥエルブ$$... No, $$マリーダ・クルス$$... I will save you, no matter what...!」

166:t_104:2.en:
$$シャア$$
($$ララァ$$... The possibility you showed me did not warp her fate...!)

166:t_104:3.en:
$$シャア$$
(So I will save her! I refuse to accept that humanity's new possibility could make anyone unhappy!)

166:t_105:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The former $$赤い彗星$$, reduced to meager guerrilla activity. How far you have fallen.」

166:t_105:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I have no attachment to the name $$赤い彗星$$...! All the more so when I look at you, bound by such a thing...!」

166:t_105:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It is not a matter of personal feelings. It is the result of the people of space wishing me to be so.」

166:t_105:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「A man who can save only a portion of humanity, even if it's the majority, thinks he'll save the world...!」

166:t_105:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「I don't believe such a man has the caliber to move the age!」

166:t_105:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's unfortunate, $$シャア・アズナブル$$. Had you been willing, I was even considering welcoming you as my right hand.」

166:t_105:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter how far we go, we remain parallel lines...! Yes... just like the many worlds that were never meant to intersect!」

166:t_106:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$. If you wish to stop the fighting, come to me with that $$ガンダム$$.」

166:t_106:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you know what the Box really is!」

166:t_106:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Having come this far, I have a good idea. All that remains is to prove its existence, and then everything will be over.」

166:t_106:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...I can't hand the Box over to you...!」

166:t_106:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You saw the light that enveloped $$アクシズ$$ and nothing changed in you. I don't believe you can lead the world!」

166:t_106:6.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「By rights, that is a light that should never have existed. Thanks to that light, the Box has grown in weight.」

166:t_106:8.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's enough talk. ...I'm no $$アンジェロ$$, but you have gone a little too far.」

166:t_106:9.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「To change the world, one must also show strength. I will teach you that.」

166:t_107:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! If you had just obeyed the Colonel, it would have ended easily!」

166:t_107:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$...! Why do you follow $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

166:t_107:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Can't you see that he isn't looking at any future!」

166:t_107:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Silence! The Colonel is the only one who understands my heart!」

166:t_107:4.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's why I dedicate everything to the Colonel! He is the one who will save the world... and me!」

166:t_108:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it, $$ギュネイ$$! I don't want to fight you!」

166:t_108:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Come at me for real, $$クェス$$! I'll show you the $$ニュータイプ$$ power I learned from you!」

166:t_108:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then even you will pick me over the Colonel...」

166:t_108:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「Idiot! That's not what a $$ニュータイプ$$ is!」

166:t_108:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「When you said you'd stop the Colonel if he did anything reckless, you were someone who understood! And yet...!」
